resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the Godwin location as Private and gives no coordinates; the story gives none either.

notes_for_editor: Build year, builder, height and move date are not in any source read (two searches, register and association pages; the WV Division of Forestry list PDF host did not resolve). Godwin standing status rests on the Forest Fire Lookout Association list alone and is unverified on site. The Godwin name appears on that list above the relocated row. The list marks the location Private but does not state ownership, so ownership is unknown.
